item.description:
### Added - **Port Killer (`⌃ ⌥ ⌘ P`)** — inspect active listening TCP ports, pin favorite dev ports, and stop or force-kill stuck servers in one click with macOS authorization when needed - **Status Bar Menu** — choose which features, quick actions, and custom commands appear in the menu-bar popover, and reorder features in Settings - Global toggle shortcuts for **Dock Click to Minimize** and **Scroll Direction**, plus `⌘ 1`–`⌘ 9` quick-paste in the Clipboard History popover - **Developer Tools** — hidden PIN-gated workspace in Settings & About for simulating software updates and release notes, testing toasts and Accessibility states, monitoring live module events and window order, testing global hotkeys and config diffs, and verifying code signing and Gatekeeper health
### Changed - Inline click-to-record shortcut controls across all modules with F-key and arrow-key support, clear/reset buttons, and one-click conflict resolution - Streamlined **Custom Commands** layout with compact expandable rows, a collapsible builder, top-positioned output, and a menu-bar toggle
### Fixed - Confined the **Scroll Direction** test pad to the sample list bounds so scrolling elsewhere on the settings page works normally - Centered the software update dialog cleanly over the Toolbox window across all download and install stages
